reasoning.summary: The document is a Co-Development Agreement between PhaseBio Pharmaceuticals Inc. and SFJ Pharmaceuticals X, Ltd., effective January 9, 2020. The scan identified key operative clauses in the Miscellaneous Article (15) and Term/Termination Article (14). Key obligations extracted include anti-assignment restrictions, change of control termination rights, non-solicitation of employees, limitation of liability (cap/exclusion), and no third-party beneficiaries. Termination clauses cover breach, at-will, material adverse event, regulatory failure, bankruptcy, change of control, safety concerns, compliance breaches, patent impact, and JSC decision. The term expires upon the last Approval Payment or earlier termination.
